reviews.x: I am 50 years old, have an olive complexion and very dry skin.  This foundation is moisturizing and the "Natural Glow" is perfect for my complexion.  I recently started using Retin A and wanted a foundation that contained sunscreen, would moisturize and not settle in my wrinkles at the end of the day.  It  works as I desired.  I am happy with the product.

I have been purchadong foundation the last 6 months, looking for the right color and balance for my skin...age 61. I have found it....and I turned around right after I applied it on my face and purchased another. Perfect price...perfect light foundation...feels like nothing...but covers nicely...perfect under eyes too!
It's amazing I found this product online. I was just "guessing" it would be good and in fact, it's great. Great for aging skin and makes me look "fresh."

reviews.t: Subtle glow and decent coverage make this  a score!

I had been using Revision and was looking for a cheaper alternative that combined moisturizer, subtle coverage and spf. ...3 in one..In some ways I may even prefer this one with the exception of the lower spf. It gives a subtle glow and even gives a kind of sun kissed look (given the too paleness created by spf and exfoliating) and gives the proper amount of coverage without looking "made up". Better than any expensive tinted moisturizer I've tried! Neutral glow has pink under tones I usually try to stay away from. But reading previous reviews, it seems to work well with almost all skin tones in this realm. Cool or warm. First use and I like. While others made my dry skin more prominent, this did not. It gives you nice coverage without feeling heavy.  If you want more coverage  you can add second layer after first application has set.

reviews.t: Lovely light coverage foundation at half the cost!
reviews.x: I absolutely love this foundation. It's very dewy and light and glides right on your skin. This is almost identical to one I was buying in my dermatologist's office but at half the price. The tube is identical to the one I'd been using so I think it's the same. The added sun protection is a bonus!

reviews.t: I really like the color and the glow to this foundation
reviews.x: I really like the color and the glow to this foundation.  The only reason I didn't give it 5 stars is that the coverage is a little heavier than I like, but is easily remedied by mixing it with make-up moisturizer.  I would purchase again.

Packaging is quite minimalist and that threw me off. It didn’t have a brand name which made me worry I ordered the wrong product. I’ve only used two times and I am really loving the coverage. Very natural. Not cakey at all.
I don't use foundation or face powder.  This is light tinted moisturizer- adds dewy look & gives a little coverage.  It's not messy & adds just enough color & coverage to blend out unevenness.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the lightweight, sheer coverage that evens out skin tone without feeling heavy.
Many customers find it moisturizing and well-suited to dry or aging skin, giving a fresh, dewy look.
Several reviewers appreciate the value, calling it a cheaper alternative to pricier foundations and tinted moisturizers.
A few reviewers report problems with packaging, including a pump that stops working and inconsistent color from the tube.
Some negative experiences mention irritation or dermatitis and the foundation highlighting fine lines and wrinkles.
